prince-george.title: New anti-gang unit for northern B.C. launched in Prince George
prince-george.description: A new regional anti-gang unit for northern B.C. has officially launched in Prince George, announced during a press conference on Thursday.

cariboo.title: 2 candidates vie to be Lytton's mayor 5 years after devastating fire
cariboo.description: Voters in Lytton, B.C., will choose between two current council members in the race for mayor.
